objects.name: ghost-paw
objects.description: GhostPaw — Background non-focus-stealing computer-use & multi-sub-agent parallel Neon Hollow cursor engine (supports occluded window passthrough click/type, background app launch, and independent sub-agent cursors).

zh-CN.title: GhostPaw — 后台无感透传 Computer-Use 与多智能体幻影猫爪光标
zh-CN.description: 支持后台静默激活/启动窗口、遮挡窗口消息透传点击与输入、DWM 后台截图，以及主/子 Agent 并行互不干扰的霓虹空心猫爪鼠标覆盖层。

en-US.title: GhostPaw — Background Computer-Use & Multi-Agent Neon Hollow Cursor
en-US.description: Background window activation + occluded window passthrough click/type + multi-sub-agent parallel Neon Hollow GhostPaw cursors without stealing physical mouse or focus.
